verdict: Borderline component with significant inline business logic. WR-02 trustLevel narrowing + computeTrustTone helper are exported and tested. Inline derivation in render (roas/ctr/cpc/cpm/cpa/info, mappedCampaignKeys check, isCurrentlyOff) is mostly pure formula. 1 LOW finding (variable shadow on `info` inside roasShopify cell — block-scoped so safe but confusing). 1 LOW finding (TONE_BG duplicated across 3 files per JSDoc — accepted target-soft-cap tradeoff, flagged as accepted-debt). No new HIGH/CRIT issues beyond the already-fixed audit items.

findings.failing_input: Reader scanning the roasShopify cell IIFE
findings.expected: Outer `info` (line 285, roasLabel result) and inner `info` (line 499, trueRevenueByKey.get result) should have distinct names to avoid lexical shadowing

findings.fix_sketch: Rename inner to `trueInfo` (matches the type TrueRevenueInfo) at line 499. Type-only change, no behavior diff.
findings.regression_test_idea: Not test-worthy — pure readability; lint rule `no-shadow` would catch this class of issue.

findings.actual: Duplication is acknowledged in the JSDoc per D-04 target-soft cap. Maintenance burden: any new tone bucket requires 3 simultaneous edits
findings.fix_sketch: Defer per existing architectural decision; promote when a 4th consumer appears or when tone palette changes
